rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; [11C]-(+)-PHNO data from 2 scanners at the same site (Invicro, London); [18F]FDOPA data from 5 scanners across 3 imaging sites (MRC Cyclotron Unit, London; Invicro, London; Bundang Hospital, South Korea).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Data were acquired with five different scanners (Siemens Hi-Rez Biograph 6, Siemens Biograph 40 TruePoint, Siemens TruePoint 6, ECAT HR + 962, and ECAT EXACT 3D) in three different imaging sites (MRC Cyclotron Unit, London; Invicro, London and Bundang Hospital, South Korea)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohorts assembled from prior in-house PET studies; none of the named datasets appear in the predefined EPD list.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Data from 77 HC (Table 1) from two previous studies [40, 41], acquired with [ 11 C]-( + )-PHNO, were used to assess and"; "6-[ 18 F]fluoro-L-DOPA (FDOPA) data from 142 HC and 109 patients with psychotic disorders from previous studies [7, 13, 14, 42 -48] were used for estimating the NM of dopamine synthesis capacity"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC reference cohorts. Model-1: 77 HC from two [11C]-(+)-PHNO studies (PET/CT N=54, PET/MR N=23). Model-2: 142 HC from five [18F]FDOPA datasets (FDOPA_01 N=61, FDOPA_02 N=26, FDOPA_03 N=12, FDOPA_HC01 N=36, FDOPA_HC02 N=7).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Data from 77 HC (Table 1) from two previous studies [40, 41], acquired with [ 11 C]-( + )-PHNO, were used to assess"; "6-[ 18 F]fluoro-L-DOPA (FDOPA) data from 142 HC and 109 patients with psychotic disorders from previous studies [7, 13, 14, 42 -48] were used for estimating the NM"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase. Model-1: totals computed by summing PET/CT (22F/32M) and PET/MR (12F/11M) HC counts from Table 1. Model-2: Table 1 reports sex per-dataset including patients; HC-only sex breakdown for the combined 142-HC reference cohort is not separately reported.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age in years. Model-1: weighted mean and pooled SD computed from PET/CT (N=54, mean=26.52, SD=7.87) and PET/MR (N=23, mean=24.39, SD=4.90) HC statistics in Table 1. Model-2: Table 1 age statistics are per-dataset totals (HC+patients); HC-only age for the combined 142-HC reference cohort is not separately reported.
